title: fix(svm): restore server-signed channel refunds after restart
quote: After a client restart, refund lookup rewrote server-signed requirements to client mode before checking durable storage. With channel discovery disabled, this skipped the exact persisted server-signed record and raised NoBatchChannelToRefundError.

title: fix(svm): restore server-signed channel refunds after restart (Go port)
quote: Port of https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/3637 from TypeScript to Go SDK.

title: fix: derive batch-settlement charge baseline from onchain totalClaimed
quote: Fixes the batch-settlement charged-amount baseline when the server has no local channel record (after a full refund, idle auto-refund, or restart). Previously the baseline was inferred from the client-signed voucher.

title: fix(svm): enforce settled + amount minimum at batch facilitator verify
quote: Mirrors the facilitator-side minimum-advance rule from EVM PR #3655 for SVM batch-settlement in TypeScript and Go: client voucher verify and top-up deposit vouchers must satisfy maxClaimableAmount >= settled + requirements.amount

title: Apple says it's tightening macOS Full Disk Access controls due to new risks from AI agents
quote: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS's Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users' files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.

title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents 'substantially' increase risk
quote: Apple says it's rolling out new controls to ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action.

title: Apple changes Full Disk Access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents
quote: Meta says FDA isn't sufficient to Muse reading messages. Apple begs to differ.

title: AI shopping agents need receipts
quote: A range of payments players from Stripe to Google to the FIDO Alliance, along with the three largest U.S. card networks, are working to coalesce around technical standards for agent transactions that will work across the industry.
